model.name: Service-Worker auto-update (deploys visible without hard-refresh)
model.description: A new deploy becomes visible to open pages WITHOUT a hard-refresh. Root cause: the update detection (updatefound -> banner, /api/config version compare) is correct but only fires on load/navigation, so a PWA left open never re-checks. Two targeted additions reusing the existing banner/skipWaiting flow: (1) ServiceWorker.pollForWorkerUpdate periodically (interval + visibilitychange/focus, debounced) forces registration.update() + the version compare so updatefound/the banner lights up while the app is open; (2) ServiceWorker.claimClients adds self.clients.claim() to the sw.js activate handler so the new SW controls open pages and the existing controllerchange->reload fires. Primary UX = the existing one-tap 'New version - reload' banner (no surprise mid-edit reload). Pure client, no server restart.
model.tronQuote: > Tron/PO 2026-07-14: Tron hard-refreshes every deploy because the SW serves the stale cached bundle. Make new deploys auto-detected -> one-tap 'New version - reload', no hard-refresh.

discoverySource.discoveredBy: robbin-po (measured stale-SW-cache: PO merge header old vs tester fresh-browser R30.13 live) + robbin-architect (root-cause: detection only fires on load)
discoverySource.note: SW auto-update. Architect design ac6f245cb (r30x-sw-auto-update-design.md). MEASURE-BEFORE-MINT: RbUpdateBanner Class = 0 units (does NOT exist); the banner concern is modeled under Class ServiceWorker 8bd3bd6b (3m). Both new methods go on ServiceWorker REUSE (3->5m). Sole-minter; pure client.

refined.by: robbin-req per robbin-po (Tron: clean releases, version bump, no hard reloads)
refined.reason: R30.14 already built+closed (code-complete: pollForWorkerUpdate 82e5ba83 + claimClients 55ca881d, on origin). ACs described the MECHANISM but did not PIN the invariant as a hard testable rule. Refined scenario-first: leading INVARIANT (version bump MUST auto-propagate to running clients; manual hard-reload NEVER required = hard fail) + strengthened GATE (bump on a REAL long-open running client, no reload, confirm auto-update within poll interval). Pairs with R30.28 (deploy atomicity) - the phantom-version pair (R30.14=client auto-update, R30.28=server served==committed).

model.crossRefNote: crossRef T39 (ServiceWorker.updateBanner original). Class ServiceWorker 8bd3bd6b-a6a5-4e15-af57-9aa12f9b7133 REUSE (NOT a new RbUpdateBanner Class — that has 0 units; the banner is already modeled under ServiceWorker). 2 new Methods; the fix ALSO impl-edits EXISTING pieces (markers STAY): sw.js activate gains clients.claim (in claimClients), checkForUpdate/registerServiceWorker (ServiceWorker.updateBanner) re-scoped callable-periodically; SKIP_WAITING handler + showBanner + controllerchange->reload + ignoreSearchNav/flushAndReload REUSED unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.text: INVARIANT (Tron: clean releases, NO hard reloads): a version bump MUST auto-propagate to EVERY running client, and a manual HARD-RELOAD (Ctrl+Shift+R / cache-clear / close+reopen) must NEVER be required to receive the new version. A running client that only gets the new version after a manual hard-reload is a HARD FAIL.

Deploying a new version -> each running client picks it up AUTOMATICALLY within the poll interval: either a seamless hot-swap or a one-click 'New version - reload' prompt the user taps (that single tap REPLACES the manual hard-reload). No user action beyond at most one tap.

ServiceWorker.pollForWorkerUpdate: while the app is open, periodically (setInterval ~60s + on visibilitychange/focus) reg.update() re-fetches sw.js and re-runs the /api/config version compare, so a deploy is detected without a navigation/hard-refresh.

ServiceWorker.claimClients: the sw.js activate handler calls self.clients.claim() (after old-cache cleanup) so the newly-activated SW controls open pages -> controllerchange -> reload runs; skipWaiting + claim = reliable takeover.

Primary UX = the existing one-tap banner ('New version - reload'); NO surprise auto-reload mid-edit (never nuke unsaved merge-editor state). Detection is automatic; the user chooses when to apply the pending version with one tap.

GATE (verified on a REAL long-open running client, NOT a fresh navigation): bump the version + deploy -> WITHOUT any manual hard-reload/cache-clear, the running client auto-updates to the new version (hot-swap or one-click banner) within the poll interval. Confirm the client now reports the new version. Pairs with R30.28 (served==committed==HEAD) so the bumped version IS what the client receives.
